fix_instructions: To make this scenario require multi-agent coordination, modify the public facts so that the draft terms appear acceptable or neutral on their own. Specifically, adjust the public exposure and reserve requirements so that the lone decision-maker cannot determine if the risk is too high without knowing the specific mitigation values (PF1: maximum_bank_exposure_usd and loss_reserve_usd) or the presence of credit support (PF4: parent_guarantee_usd).
